name: Frontier Mech: Beyond
description:
About This Game

About This Game

Pilot powerful combat mechs. Break through relentless insectoid swarms. Deploy tactical drones, complete high-risk missions, and fight your way to extraction with valuable loot.

Frontier Mech: Beyond is a third-person sci-fi mech action game combining intense combat, tactical drone support, customizable loadouts, and extraction-based missions.

Choose from five distinct combat mechs, deploy one of four tactical drone types, and customize your arsenal with weapons, skills, and equipment modules.

Fight. Scavenge. Extract. Upgrade. Prepare for your next deployment.

A Landing Gone Wrong

A massive military operation on a remote frontier planet falls apart before the invasion force can establish a foothold.

Dropships are shot down. Communications break down. The landing force is scattered.

You play as Ash, a mech pilot stranded behind enemy lines after a disastrous landing. Cut off from his squad and running low on supplies, he receives an urgent mission from command.

Fight through abandoned colonies and swarm-infested territory, restore vital military infrastructure, and uncover the secrets buried beneath a planet sealed off from humanity for twenty years.

Five Mechs. Five Ways to Fight.

Choose your mech and take control of the battlefield.

Dash through enemy formations in a lightweight mech armed with rapid-fire cannons and multi-target missiles. Mark priority targets with sustained fire and finish them with homing projectiles. Deploy a heavy siege mech and unleash devastating artillery barrages.

Prefer precision? Charge your sniper cannon for powerful long-range shots, or manually guide explosive projectiles around obstacles. For close-range assaults, raise a heavy shield, push through incoming fire, and clear enemy swarms with flamethrowers.

Each mech features its own weapons, unique abilities, and progression tree.

Face overwhelming swarms, heavily armored enemies, dangerous elites, and massive bosses. Master your weapons, movement, and abilities to overcome each encounter.

Tactical Drones. More Ways to Win.

Bring a tactical drone into battle and expand your combat options.

Choose from four specialized drone types:

  • Sentinel Drone: Delivers autonomous fire support and offensive abilities.

  • Heavy Firepower Drone: Provides sustained fire and devastating area attacks.

  • Engineering Drone: Deploys defensive turrets and maintains battlefield equipment.

  • Support Drone: Offers repairs, protection, and improved survivability.

Customize your drone with interchangeable skill modules. Establish defensive positions, call in bombardments, deploy additional firepower, or request emergency supplies when the situation turns against you.

Your mech defines how you fight. Your drone expands what you can do.

Fight. Scavenge. Extract.

Every deployment brings new objectives, valuable resources, and difficult decisions.

Explore abandoned facilities, search supply caches, and recover rare materials and equipment modules while fighting through hostile territory.

But your cargo space, ammunition, and repair supplies are limited.

Do you push deeper into enemy territory for a chance at better loot, or head for extraction with what you've already secured?

Extract successfully to bring your hard-earned resources back to base. If your mech is destroyed, you lose the contents of your deployment inventory—but a special recovery mission may give you a chance to reclaim them.

Every mission is a balance of firepower, risk, and reward.

Build Your Ultimate Mech Loadout

Turn the resources you recover into greater combat power.

Upgrade each mech through its dedicated progression tree, improving weapons, signature abilities, mobility, and survivability.

Equip armor, core, and weapon modules to fine-tune your build. Discover equipment with different tiers, base attributes, and randomized bonuses.

Customize your drone with additional core and skill modules to complement your preferred combat style.

Back at base, use shops and workshops to acquire supplies, dismantle unwanted equipment, craft new modules, and prepare for your next operation.

Build for rapid assaults, precision strikes, sustained firepower, or heavily fortified defense. Experiment with different mech and drone combinations to find the loadout that works for you.

Choose Your Missions. Shape Your Progression.

Beyond the main campaign, take on military contracts, explore dangerous regions, and pursue time-sensitive intelligence missions offering greater risks and rewards.

Each operation presents different objectives and opportunities. Completing a deployment advances the campaign's timeline, while available missions and market supplies may change.

Decide where to deploy, what equipment to bring, and which rewards are worth pursuing.

Unlock additional mechs, drones, equipment, and base facilities as the campaign progresses, expanding your options for future missions.

Beyond the Battlefield

Twenty years ago, an insectoid catastrophe turned a once-prosperous frontier colony into a quarantined world.

Now, an attack on humanity's capital has brought war back to the planet.

Military forces return to reclaim the surface. Insectoid swarms occupy abandoned cities and mines. And deep within the quarantine zone, human survivors still struggle to endure.

As Ash ventures further into the conflict, he begins to discover that the war is about far more than exterminating the swarms.

The battlefield is only the beginning. The truth lies beyond.
short_desc: Frontier Mech: Beyond is a third-person sci-fi mech action game. Pilot distinct combat mechs, fight alongside tactical drones, and venture into a frontier world overrun by insectoid swarms. Complete missions, scavenge resources, extract safely, and upgrade your arsenal to uncover the truth.
